package consumer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/migrations"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/migrations/backend"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/schema/ir"
)

func HistoricalStates(applied migrations.AppliedState) ([]migrations.ProjectState, error) {
	initial := migrations.MigrationKey{App: "news", Name: "0001_initial"}
	second := migrations.MigrationKey{App: "news", Name: "0002_summary"}
	reconstructor, err := migrations.NewStateReconstructor(
		migrations.Migration{
			App:  initial.App,
			Name: initial.Name,
			Operations: []migrations.Operation{
				migrations.CreateModel{
					AppLabel: "news",
					Model: ir.Model{
						Name:    "article",
						GoName:  "Article",
						DBTable: "news_article",
						Fields: []ir.Field{
							{Name: "id", GoName: "ID", Column: "id", Kind: ir.FieldAuto, PrimaryKey: true},
						},
					},
				},
			},
		},
		migrations.Migration{
			App:          second.App,
			Name:         second.Name,
			Dependencies: []migrations.MigrationKey{initial},
			Operations: []migrations.Operation{
				migrations.AddField{
					AppLabel:  "news",
					ModelName: "article",
					Field: ir.Field{
						Name:      "summary",
						GoName:    "Summary",
						Column:    "summary",
						Kind:      ir.FieldChar,
						Nullable:  true,
						MaxLength: 200,
					},
				},
			},
		},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	requests := []migrations.StateRequest{
		migrations.EmptyStateRequest(),
		migrations.LatestStateRequest(),
		migrations.BeforeStateRequest(second),
		migrations.AfterStateRequest(initial, second),
		migrations.AppliedStateRequest(applied),
	}
	states := make([]migrations.ProjectState, 0, len(requests)+1)
	for _, request := range requests {
		state, err := reconstructor.Reconstruct(request)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		states = append(states, state)
	}

	var zero migrations.StateReconstructor
	empty, err := zero.Reconstruct(migrations.EmptyStateRequest())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return append(states, empty), nil
}

func MigrateLoaded(ctx context.Context, definitions []migrations.Migration, target migrations.Target) (migrations.ProjectState, error) {
	port := &externalLifecyclePort{}
	executor := migrations.Executor{Backend: port}
	if target == (migrations.Target{}) {
		return executor.Migrate(ctx, definitions, migrations.LatestLifecycleRequest())
	}
	return executor.Migrate(ctx, definitions, migrations.TargetedLifecycleRequest(target))
}

var (
	_ backend.AtomicBackend             = (*externalLifecyclePort)(nil)
	_ backend.RevisionFencedBackend     = (*externalLifecyclePort)(nil)
	_ backend.RevisionFencedSession     = (*externalLifecyclePort)(nil)
	_ backend.Transaction               = (*externalLifecyclePort)(nil)
	_ backend.RevisionFencedTransaction = (*externalLifecyclePort)(nil)
	_ error                             = &backend.RevisionFenceError{Kind: backend.RevisionFenceFailureIntegrity}
	_ migrations.ErrorCategory          = migrations.CategoryConflict
	_ migrations.ErrorCode              = migrations.CodeCommitOutcomeUnknown
)

type externalLifecyclePort struct{}

func (p *externalLifecyclePort) BeginMigration(context.Context) (backend.Transaction, error) {
	return p, nil
}

func (p *externalLifecyclePort) OpenRevisionFencedSession(context.Context) (backend.RevisionFencedSession, error) {
	return p, nil
}

func (*externalLifecyclePort) ReadAppliedMigrations(context.Context) ([]backend.AppliedMigration, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (p *externalLifecyclePort) BeginFencedMigration(context.Context, backend.HistoryTransition) (backend.RevisionFencedTransaction, error) {
	return p, nil
}

func (*externalLifecyclePort) Close(context.Context) error { return nil }

func (*externalLifecyclePort) CreateModel(context.Context, ir.Model) error           { return nil }
func (*externalLifecyclePort) DeleteModel(context.Context, ir.Model) error           { return nil }
func (*externalLifecyclePort) AddField(context.Context, ir.Model, ir.Field) error    { return nil }
func (*externalLifecyclePort) RemoveField(context.Context, ir.Model, ir.Field) error { return nil }
func (*externalLifecyclePort) RecordApplied(context.Context, string, string) error   { return nil }
func (*externalLifecyclePort) RecordUnapplied(context.Context, string, string) error { return nil }
func (*externalLifecyclePort) Commit(context.Context) error                          { return nil }
func (*externalLifecyclePort) Rollback(context.Context) error                        { return nil }

func (*externalLifecyclePort) CommitFenced(context.Context) (backend.CommitOutcome, error) {
	return backend.CommitOutcome{Durability: backend.CommitCommitted}, nil
}
